All twelve are registered in `data/ssls-3.0/canon.json` as SSLS3-CANON-001, authority class INDEX ONLY — NON-CONTROLLING. This disposition changes nothing above: the items were observed in connected storage at the stated time, and the location class recorded for each item is the location at observation, not a current address. Transcription is copying, not adoption; reconstruction is composition, not discovery. Neither promotes anything, and the twelve documents remain CANDIDATE with zero authorizing decisions.
